summary: When a resident calls it trespassing, the canvasser apologizes, says they are leaving, and is gone in under a minute.
realLife: A new canvasser in one account was told he was trespassing, apologized, said he would go and moved to the next door.
sources: Dave Fleischer Substack, The fear you feel before you knock, undated: https://davefleischer.substack.com/p/the-fear-you-feel-before-you-knock
inGame: resident's hostile reply on the door record; the player's choice to leave

turns.pulledBy: a hostile reply and a calm canvasser
turns.writesBack: the door record ends with no mark against the resident

turns.pulledBy: pride or anger in the canvasser's traits
turns.writesBack: a complaint or a bad story about the campaign
